notes: «غير، واحد» is read as an unnamed co-transmitter («غير واحد»), converging with Salama and Hatim at «قالوا حدثنا عبد الرزاق»
«وزاد حاتم ... قال معمر بلغني عن الزهري» is a wording addition and a gap remark on the same chain, not a new transmitter; left out
Shu'ayb and Sufyan ibn Uyayna each give the saying through a different transmitter list (variant groups); Sufyan's omits Abd al-Rahman, as the text states
